problems.title: Equality of two logarithms with a restrictive domain
problems.question: Solve log₁/₂(x²+2x)=log₁/₂(x-18).
problems.idea: Equal logarithms to the same valid base have equal arguments.
formulas: Arguments must be positive; log_b u=log_b v iff u=v on that domain.
steps: The second argument requires x>18, which also makes the first positive.
Its discriminant is 1-72=-71<0. Thus no real input solves it, even before the domain restriction.

problems.title: Domain with a square root in the logarithm base
problems.question: Find the domain of y=log_(√(x-3))((2x-2)/x).
problems.idea: A logarithm base must be strictly positive and different from one.
steps: The base equals 1 at x=4, which must be excluded.
For every x>3, (2x-2)/x=2-2/x>0, so the argument introduces no further restriction.

problems.title: A variable-base logarithmic inequality
problems.question: Solve log_(x²+2)((3x-1)/x)≤0.
problems.idea: The base always exceeds one, so the argument must lie in (0,1].
steps: The base x²+2 is greater than one for all real x.
The argument is 3-1/x. Positivity gives x<0 or x>1/3.

problems.title: Cylinder aspect ratio from an area relation
problems.question: A cylinder’s lateral area is twice its base-disk area. Find height divided by radius.
problems.idea: Substitute the two area formulas.
steps: For a nondegenerate cylinder r>0, divide by 2πr.

problems.title: Unfold a cone with an equilateral axial section
problems.question: A cone’s axial section is equilateral. Find its lateral sector’s central angle.
problems.idea: The equilateral condition makes the generator equal to the base diameter.
steps: The unfolded sector is therefore a semicircle.

problems.title: Sphere radius from a volume-to-area ratio
problems.question: A sphere’s volume and surface area have numerical ratio 2:3. Find its radius.
problems.idea: Their ratio simplifies to one-third of the radius.
steps: The positive radius meets the nondegenerate-sphere requirement.

problems.title: A limit evaluated by continuity
problems.question: Find lim as x→0 of (√(x+1)+√(x+4))/(x+1).
problems.idea: The radicals and denominator are continuous near zero, and the denominator limit is nonzero.
formulas: The limit of a continuous expression is its value, provided all operations remain defined.
steps: There is no zero-over-zero form, so direct substitution gives 3.

problems.title: Ratio of small-angle sine functions
problems.question: Find lim as x→0 of 3sin2x/(2sin3x).
problems.idea: Normalise each sine by its own angle.
steps: Rewrite as [sin2x/(2x)]/[sin3x/(3x)], because the constants 3·2 and 2·3 cancel.
The denominator limit is nonzero, so the ratio tends to 1.

problems.title: An exponential sequence limit
problems.question: Find lim as n→∞ of (1+2/n)ⁿ.
problems.idea: Use the standard exponential limit with parameter two.
steps: The bracket tends to 1, so the logarithm tends to 2.

problems.title: Volume of a conical frustum
problems.question: A conical frustum has radii 2,4 and height 3. Find its volume.
problems.idea: Apply the frustum volume formula directly.

problems.title: Plane through three axis intercepts
problems.question: Find the plane through A=(1,0,0), B=(0,1,0), C=(0,0,1).
problems.idea: Use the intercept form of a plane.
formulas: A plane with nonzero axis intercepts a,b,c has equation x/a+y/b+z/c=1.
steps: Each given point satisfies it, and the three points are noncollinear, so they determine this unique plane.

problems.title: Distance from the origin to a plane
problems.question: Find the distance from (0,0,0) to plane 2x+3y-4z-1=0.
problems.idea: Divide the absolute substituted plane value by the normal-vector length.
steps: The numerator at the origin is |-1|=1.

problems.title: Differentiate three nested functions
problems.question: Differentiate y=e^(cos√x).
problems.idea: Apply the chain rule through exponential, cosine and square root.
steps: The square root contributes 1/(2√x). Multiply the three factors.
problems.answer: $y′=-e^{\cos\sqrt x}\sin\sqrt x/(2\sqrt x)$ for x>0 (option ე).
problems.note: The real function also exists at x=0. Its right-hand derivative there is -e/2, obtained from sin√x/√x→1; the displayed ordinary derivative formula is for the interior x>0.

problems.title: Minimum of a number plus a scaled reciprocal
problems.question: Find the minimum of a+4/a for a>0.
problems.idea: Subtract the suspected minimum and factor a square.
steps: The right side is nonnegative because a>0.
Equality holds at a=2, so the lower bound is attained.

problems.title: Largest rectangle inscribed in an equilateral triangle
problems.question: An equilateral triangle has side 1. An inscribed rectangle has one side on the triangle base. Find its greatest area.
problems.idea: Use similar triangles to express the available width at height t.
steps: The rectangle’s top corners lie on the two sloping sides, so its width is 1-t/H.
The maximum is H/4, attained at half the triangle height.
With H=√3/2, the maximum area is √3/8.

problems.title: Ellipse from its foci and distance sum
problems.question: An ellipse has foci (-3,0),(3,0), and every distance sum to the foci is 10. Find its equation.
problems.idea: The sum equals 2a, and the focus distance c determines b.
formulas: For a horizontal ellipse, x²/a²+y²/b²=1, with c²=a²-b².
steps: 2a=10 gives a=5; the foci give c=3.
Substitute these squared semiaxes into the standard equation.

problems.title: Hyperbola from its foci and distance difference
problems.question: A hyperbola has foci (-5,0),(5,0). The absolute difference of distances to them is 8. Find its equation.
problems.idea: The difference equals 2a; for a hyperbola, c²=a²+b².
steps: 2a=8 gives a=4, and the foci give c=5.

problems.title: A parabola with an incompletely specified directrix
problems.question: A parabola has focus (2,0) and a directrix parallel to the y-axis in the left half-plane. Which listed equation is possible?
problems.idea: The listed standard equation uses vertex at the origin, but the stated directrix position alone allows a family.
formulas: For focus (p,0), directrix x=-p and vertex (0,0), y²=4px.
steps: Among the choices y²=kx, the focus is (k/4,0). To match (2,0), k=8.
The equation y²=8x has directrix x=-2, which meets the stated condition.
More generally the unspecified directrix x=d<0 gives y²=2(2-d)(x-(2+d)/2). These are other possible parabolas.
Thus y²=8x is the valid listed choice, while uniqueness would require fixing the directrix or vertex.
problems.note: The text only locates the directrix in the left half-plane; it does not explicitly give its x-coordinate.

problems.title: A tangent parallel to a given line
problems.question: Find the tangent to y=x⁴ parallel to y=32x.
problems.idea: Match its derivative to the required slope.
steps: The line is y-16=32(x-2), hence y=32x-48.

problems.title: An oblique asymptote
problems.question: Find an oblique asymptote of y=x-1/x.
problems.idea: Subtract the candidate line and test whether the difference tends to zero.
formulas: y=mx+b is an asymptote when f(x)-(mx+b)→0 as x→±∞.
steps: This tends to zero in either infinite direction.
Therefore y=x is the oblique asymptote.

problems.title: Find an inflection input
problems.question: At which x does y=x³-x² have an inflection point?
problems.idea: Use a second derivative that changes sign.
steps: For x<1/3 the second derivative is negative, and for x>1/3 it is positive.
The concavity changes, so x=1/3 is genuinely an inflection input.

problems.title: Rotate a 5–5–4 triangle about an equal side
problems.question: An isosceles triangle has sides 5,5,4. Find the solid volume formed by rotating it about one equal side.
problems.idea: The perpendicular from the third vertex creates two cones sharing a base.
formulas: Rotation radius ρ=2Δ/L, where rotation side L=5.
steps: The altitude to the side of length 4 is √(25-4)=√21, so Δ=2√21.
The radius perpendicular to the rotation side is ρ=4√21/5.
The two cone heights sum to the rotation-side length 5.
problems.note: None of the printed choices equals 112π/5. The listed 112π/25 omits the factor from the total cone height.

problems.title: Integrate a rational expression term by term
problems.question: Evaluate ∫ from 1 to 2 of (x²+3x+5)/x dx.
problems.idea: Divide each numerator term by x before integrating.

problems.title: Area under one sine arch
problems.question: Find the area between y=sinx and the x-axis on [0,π].
problems.idea: Sine is nonnegative on this interval, so its definite integral is the area.
steps: The area is [-cosx] from 0 to π.
At π the value is 1, and at 0 it is -1.

problems.title: Disk-method volume for a square-root curve
problems.question: Find the solid volume obtained by rotating the region under y=√x about the x-axis for 1≤x≤√2.
problems.idea: Use circular cross-section disks of radius √x.
problems.note: The printed answer list omits π. Its value 1/2 is the integral without the disk-area factor π; the actual geometric volume is π/2.
